about.title: A school built on technology.
about.lede: Digital School is a technology school for children and young people aged 8–18, focused on programming and digital skills.

motto.text: Our vision is to equip children and young people with the skills they need to succeed in a world where technology and digital literacy are part of every profession.

global.title: Digital School around the world
global.lede: Through this international network we share experience, methodology, ideas and partnership opportunities with Digital School centers across the globe.

p1.bio: Arjeta built her career at the intersection of education, management and people development. She holds a Master's degree from the Faculty of Technology and Metallurgy at Ss. Cyril and Methodius University in Skopje and is an engineer in Biochemistry, bringing over 25 years of experience in formal education and more than 20 years in non-formal education. Since 2004 she has led private education institutions. At Digital School Macedonia, she leads with the belief that education shouldn't just prepare young people for the future — it should give them the courage and the ability to create it.

p2.bio: Azir is a university professor and holds a PhD in Computer Science. As Co-Founder and CTO, he is responsible for the curriculum, innovation and technology direction of the academy. With extensive experience in higher education, research, artificial intelligence and digital transformation, he also mentors startups and has designed innovative programs and strategies at national level. He holds a Digital Transformation certification from MIT Professional Education, USA. At Digital School Macedonia, he leads program development with one clear idea: children shouldn't grow up only as users of technology, but as its creators — able to think, experiment, and build what doesn't exist yet.

rnd.lede: Digital School has built its own curriculum as one of the school's core values. Our R&D team continuously integrates new technology trends into it, so every instructor knows exactly what to teach, how to teach it, and which tools to use.

post1.text: Digital School student Junus Aziri represented the school at an international competition in Rome, taking 2nd place in Gold Mathematics, Gold in Science, and Bronze in AI Prompt Engineering — proof that strong logic skills built in the classroom translate directly into results on the world stage.

post2.text: Bardh Sulimani brought home Gold in AI Prompt Engineering and Silver in Codementum from the Rome finals, showcasing the AI literacy Digital School builds into every advanced-level program.

post3.text: Bora Abdili swept two Gold medals — in Codementum and in AI Prompt Engineering — capping off a strong year for Digital School's competition team in Rome.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Cookies
privacy.lede: How Digital School Macedonia collects, uses and protects your information.

s1.title: 1. Information we collect
s1.text: When you fill in our contact or enrollment form, we collect the information you provide directly: your name, email address, phone number, preferred location, and message content. We do not collect payment or identity document information through this website.

s2.title: 2. How we use your information
s2.text: We use the information you submit to respond to your inquiry, provide details about our programs, and, if you enroll, to manage your child's registration. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

s3.title: 3. Data retention
s3.text: We retain contact form submissions only for as long as necessary to respond to your inquiry or, for enrolled students, for the duration of the program plus any period required by law.

s4.title: 4. Your rights
s4.text: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at info@digitalschool.com.mk.

s5.title: 5. Cookies
s5.text: We use strictly necessary cookies to remember your cookie preference and to support actions you start yourself, such as submitting a form. With your consent, we also use analytics cookies (such as Google Analytics) and advertising cookies (such as Meta Pixel) to understand site visits and measure the performance of our campaigns. You can decline these at any time — the site works the same either way.

s6.title: 6. Contact
s6.text: Questions about this policy can be sent to info@digitalschool.com.mk or any of our locations listed on the Contact page.
